name: Maxicity Holdings Limited
summary: Maxicity Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a slope works contractor in Hong Kong. The company is involved in drilling and installation of soil nails; construction of retaining walls and flexible barrier systems; and installation of debris flow protection rigid barriers. It also engages in installation of raking drains and wire meshes and mats for erosion control; construction of concrete maintenance stairways/access systems; and landscape softworks and establishment works. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
